subject: crossks: add info schema coordinator (#62712)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on infoschema/MDL coordination: `issyncer.Syncer` now takes an injected `validatorapi.Validator` and an `InfoSchemaCoordinator` getter; `sessmgr` extracts `InfoSchemaCoordinator`; server and cross-keyspace coordinators provide `CheckOldRunningTxn` for MDL job filtering and flashback connection kill hook.
